statement_hindi: नहर का पानी मिलता है, इसलिए खेतों में फसल अच्छी होती है
statement_english: Canal water reaches our fields, so the crops grow well
basis: Wikipedia (Behat town article, Economy section, undated): the Western Yamuna Canal 'irrigates most of the arable land in Behat'. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

statement_hindi: आम के बाग़ ही यहां की पहचान और रोज़ी-रोटी हैं
statement_english: Mango orchards are our pride and our livelihood
basis: Wikipedia (Behat town article, undated): 'mango orchards slowly took over as mainstay of the economy'. The same article names guavas only as one fruit the town is known for, so guava orchards are not claimed here. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

statement_hindi: हमारे कारीगरों की पीतल की घंटियां और लोहे का सामान, यही शान है
statement_english: The brass bells and wrought-iron goods our craftsmen make are our pride
basis: Wikipedia (Behat town article, introduction, undated) names 'brass bells, and wrought iron handicrafts' as local products. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

statement_hindi: *दिल्ली-यमुनोत्री हाईवे पर होने से सहारनपुर आना-जाना आसान है
statement_english: *The Delhi-Yamunotri highway makes travel to Saharanpur easy
basis: Inference: Wikipedia places Behat on NH-709B, about 30 km north of Saharanpur, and Amar Ujala (10 Dec 2021) calls the road the Delhi-Yamunotri highway. The 'easy travel' point is not stated in any source reached.

statement_hindi: *बेहट सीएचसी में पहला इलाज मिल जाता है, फिर ज़िला अस्पताल भेजते हैं
statement_english: *Behat's CHC gives first treatment in an emergency before referral
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (10 Dec 2021) reports that after a fatal three-bike crash near Babail Bujurg, the three injured were given first aid at Behat CHC and referred to the district hospital. This is one incident, not a general finding.

statement_hindi: तहसील में पैसा लेकर गरीब परिवारों की ज़मीन भू-माफिया को दी, आरोप है
statement_english: In the tehsil, money was taken and poor families' land given to a land mafia, they allege
basis: Amar Ujala (21 Feb 2025, Dimple Sirohi): Dalit and Muslim women of village Begpur Naugaanwa, Behat tehsil, locked the tehsil gate. They say more than 100 families on about 14 bigha were evicted after the Naib Tehsildar and Halka Lekhpal allegedly took money from a land mafia. These are the women's allegations, not established findings. No official response appears in the text read. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

statement_hindi: यमुना में अवैध खनन के आरोप लगे, बेहट थाने में केस दर्ज हुआ
statement_english: Illegal mining in the Yamuna is alleged, and a case was filed at Behat police station
basis: Tribune (5 Dec 2024): owners of six stone crushers and screening plants were booked for alleged illegal mining in the Yamuna on the UP side, at Pratap Pur and Alamgirpur Gurjar villages. The case was registered at Behat police station, Saharanpur. Allegations only. Not confirmed that these villages are inside the Behat AC boundary, and the article does not say which tehsil the police station serves. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

statement_hindi: सरकार ने यहां ध्यान नहीं दिया, सत्तर सालों में बेहट आगे नहीं बढ़ा
statement_english: The government has ignored this area, and Behat has barely moved forward in seventy years
basis: Wikipedia (Behat town article, History section, undated): 'the government has neglected the area; as a result, Behat has made little progress in last 70 years.' This is the article's editorial claim, not a voter statement. Verified on 12 Oct 2026.

statement_hindi: *बेहट के पास हाईवे पर तेज़ गाड़ियों से जान का खतरा रहता है
statement_english: *Speeding vehicles on the highway near Behat put lives at risk
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (10 Dec 2021) reports a fatal three-bike collision on the Delhi-Yamunotri highway near Babail Bujurg, Behat. The report does not mention speed or road conditions, and it is from 2021, so it is not recent.

statement_hindi: *आम के बागवानों को फसल का सही दाम और मदद नहीं मिलती
statement_english: *Mango growers do not get a fair price or enough support for their crop
basis: Inference: Wikipedia says mango orchards are the town's mainstay, but no price or support complaint was found in any source reached. The 2024-2026 searches did not surface a Behat report on this.

statement_hindi: सरसावा में एयरपोर्ट बन गया, यह हमारे लिए गर्व की बात है
statement_english: An airport is now built in Sarsawa, and that is a matter of pride for us
basis: Indian Infrastructure (21 Oct 2024): Saharanpur airport inaugurated on 20 Oct 2024 with Rewa and Ambikapur, under UDAN. Wikipedia places Sarsawa Airport in Sarsawa (civil enclave at Sarsawa Air Force Station), and Sarsawa is inside Nakur AC. Flight operations are not confirmed in sources. The Ministry of Civil Aviation page cited in search (Rs 54.56 crore) could not be opened and is not used.

statement_hindi: नकुड़ पुलिस ने पीड़ित की रकम वापस दिलवाई, अच्छा काम किया
statement_english: Nakur police got a victim's money returned, and they did good work
basis: Nakur news feed (aggregator) headline dated 20 Feb 2026: 'नकुड: नकुड़ पुलिस ने अध्याना निवासी पीड़ित की धनराशि कराई वापस' (Nakur police recovered money for a victim from Adhyana). Underlying Hindi outlet not identified; opened and checked this round.

statement_hindi: मुठभेड़ के बाद नकुड़ पुलिस ने बदमाश पकड़े, अच्छी बात है
statement_english: After an encounter, Nakur police arrested suspects, and that is a good thing
basis: Nakur news feed (aggregator) headline dated 29 Jul 2026: 'मुठभेड के बाद पुलिस ने किये तीन आरोपी बदमाश किये गिरफ्तार' (police arrested three accused after an encounter). The source reports arrests only, not voter satisfaction.

statement_hindi: सरसावा मिल ने किसानों को गन्ने का पैसा दिया, यह अच्छा है
statement_english: The Sarsawa sugar mill paid farmers for their cane, and that is good
basis: Amar Ujala (3 Jun 2021, district-level, verified this round): the district's mills paid Rs 100.34 crore that day, including Rs 25.01 crore by the Sarsawa mill. This is 2021 data; no 2024-26 Sarsawa payment report was found.

statement_hindi: *नकुड़, सरसावा और सुल्तानपुर में नगर पालिकाएं शहर की व्यवस्था देखती हैं
statement_english: *Nakur, Sarsawa and Sultanpur have municipal bodies that run local civic work
basis: Inference: Wikipedia (verified) lists the Nakur NPP, Sarsawa NPP and Chilkana Sultanpur NP inside the AC. Whether civic work is effective was not verified; no 2024-26 report on civic services was found.

statement_hindi: *गन्ने का बकाया मिलों पर बाकी है, पैसा कब मिलेगा?
statement_english: *Cane dues are still pending with the mills, when will the money come?
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (3 Jun 2021, district-level, verified this round) says the district's mills still owed farmers Rs 630 crore after paying Rs 100.34 crore that day. Sarsawa and Nanauta mills appear in the article as payers (Rs 25.01 crore and Rs 50.09 crore), not as named defaulters. This is 2021 data; no 2024-26 Saharanpur or Nakur dues report was found, so current arrears are unverified.

statement_hindi: शाहजहांपुर रोड पर बिना कागज़ात के रेत का ट्रक पकड़ा गया
statement_english: On the Shahjahanpur Road in Nakur, a sand truck without papers was caught
basis: Nakur news feed (aggregator) headline dated 20 Feb 2026, verified this round: 'नकुड: शाहजहांपुर रोड पर पुलिस और राजस्व टीम ने बिना प्रपत्रों के रेत से भरा ट्रक पकड़ा, किया सीज' (police and revenue staff seized a sand-laden truck without papers on the Shahjahanpur Road). The source reports a seizure only; it does not record a voter complaint about road damage or safety.

statement_hindi: *नकुड़ में बदमाशों का डर है, मुठभेड़ और गिरफ्तारी होती रहती हैं
statement_english: *Fear of criminals in Nakur, with encounters and arrests happening often
basis: Inference: the Nakur news feed (verified this round) shows an encounter and arrest of three accused on 29 Jul 2026, and a Mahashivratri feast item. Voter fear of crime is not stated in any source. The earlier dowry-harassment reference was removed because the feed does not show it.

statement_hindi: *यमुना उफनती है तो नकुड़-सरसावा के खेत और घर डूबते हैं
statement_english: *Yamuna floods can submerge fields and homes in Nakur and Sarsawa
basis: Inference from a 2018 event: Patrika (18 Aug 2018, verified this round) reports Yamuna flows of about 6 lakh cusecs from Hathnikund flooding the Nakur and Sarsawa areas, more than two deaths and over 50 rescues, and damage to the left embankment near Hathnikund barrage. Patrika's second article (29 Jul 2018) reports Sarsawa crops submerged and an expert team stationed in Nakur. No 2021-26 flood report for this AC was found, so recurrence is not shown.

statement_hindi: *नकुड़ में पानी की सप्लाई अनियमित है, हैंडपंप भी खराब रहते हैं
statement_english: *Water supply in Nakur is irregular and handpumps often do not work
basis: Inference: no Nakur-specific water report was found in the searches run this round. The Nakur news feed (checked) lists no water items for Feb-Jul 2026, which is absence of evidence only. Water complaints in this AC are unverified and need a field check.

statement_hindi: मेडिकल कॉलेज में सीटी स्कैन की सुविधा है, यह अच्छी बात है
statement_english: The government medical college has a CT scan facility, and that is a good thing
basis: UP Vidhan Parishad reply (2025 session, question on Saharanpur district): CT scan at the government medical college (Shaikh-ul-Hind Maulana Mahmood Hasan) installed 25.06.2024; ICU, PICU, digital X-ray and 24x7 blood bank listed as available. District-level; the college's Ambala Road/Beedpur location is not confirmed inside Nagar AC.

statement_hindi: खाताखेड़ी का लकड़ी का काम हज़ारों परिवारों की रोज़ी-रोटी है
statement_english: Khatakhedi's wood-carving work is the livelihood of thousands of families
basis: Aaj Tak, 6 Aug 2026 (Saharanpur correspondent): wooden craft trade centres on Khatakhedi and nearby areas; ODOP loans of Rs 87.75 crore to 506 people over nine years; district industry department cites about 350 exporting units and turnover around Rs 1,000 crore; the craft is the livelihood of thousands of families.

statement_hindi: स्मार्ट सिटी के 381 करोड़ के 15 काम, यह अच्छी बात है
statement_english: Smart City: 15 projects worth Rs 381 crore, and that is a good thing
basis: Amar Ujala, 4 Aug 2025: Chief Minister to inaugurate 15 Smart City projects worth Rs 381 crore during his Saharanpur visit. The article announces the inauguration; it does not list the projects or confirm they are complete.

statement_hindi: *मिलें समय पर चलें तो गन्ने का पैसा घर तक आता है
statement_english: *Mills that crush on time mean cane money reaches farm families
basis: Inference: no 2024-26 Saharanpur report of on-time crushing was found; cane payment is a recurring district complaint (see negative 4). District-level.

statement_hindi: *हाईवे चौड़ा होने की योजना है, तब शहर से निकलने में आसानी होगी
statement_english: *A planned highway widening would ease getting through the city
basis: Inference: Patrika (19 Apr 2018) says the Delhi-Saharanpur road widening and roadside power-line shifting were planned through the city; no 2024-26 Saharanpur city report of progress or completion was found. Loni (Ghaziabad) widening items are outside this AC.

statement_hindi: ऑपरेशन के नाम पर वसूली का आरोप, दवा बाहर से लानी पड़ती है
statement_english: They allege money is extracted in the name of surgery, and medicines must be brought from outside
basis: Amar Ujala video (22 Jan 2025): Bharatiya Kisan Union (Tomar) protest at the Chief Medical Officer's office in Saharanpur alleged illegal recovery in the name of surgery at the district hospital and medicines ordered from outside. These are the union's allegations as reported. District-level; the hospital's location inside Nagar AC is not confirmed.

statement_hindi: कांवड़ के दिनों में घंटाघर से सोफिया मार्केट तक जाम लग जाता है
statement_english: During Kanwar days, a jam builds from Ghantaghar to Sofia Market
basis: Amar Ujala, 3 Aug 2026 (photo caption): jam from Sofia Market to Ghantaghar in Saharanpur during the second-phase Kanwar route diversion (midnight 4 Aug to midnight 11 Aug 2026). City-level and seasonal, caused by the diversion.

statement_hindi: निर्माणाधीन स्मार्ट सड़क के सीवर काम पर अफसरों के बीच सवाल उठे हैं
statement_english: Officials have raised questions over sewer work on the under-construction smart road
basis: Amar Ujala, 23 Jul 2026: the Municipal Commissioner sought an explanation for extra sewer work on the under-construction CM Grid phase-2 smart road in Saharanpur, questioned the Jalkal department's earlier advice, and ordered faster work. No ward is named; city-level.

statement_hindi: *चीनी मिलों पर गन्ने का बकाया है, किसान भुगतान का इंतज़ार करते हैं
statement_english: *Sugar mills still owe cane dues and farmers keep waiting for payment
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (3 Jun 2021): district mills paid Rs 100.34 crore that day, but Rs 630 crore cane price arrears were still pending. No 2025-26 Saharanpur district dues report was found, so persistence is unverified. District-level, dated.

statement_hindi: *रिंग रोड नहीं है, इसलिए दिल्ली हाईवे शहर के बीच से निकलता है
statement_english: *There is no ring road, so the Delhi highway runs through the middle of the city
basis: Inference: Patrika (19 Apr 2018) says the Delhi-Saharanpur highway passes through the middle of the city because Saharanpur has no ring road; Court Road and the Hasanpur Chowk-Ghantaghar stretch are named as the main market area. Dated; no 2024-26 source confirms it persists. The page does not describe crowding or jams, so no such claim is made.

statement_hindi: सुना है नाले पर कार्रवाई चल रही है, यह अच्छा है
statement_english: We hear action is under way on the village drain, and that is good.
basis: District-level: PWD Executive Engineer Dharmendra Singh is quoted as saying action in the Hauzkheri drain matter is underway ("मामले में कार्रवाई प्रचलित है", wording unclear). The article gives no block or tehsil and does not name the Saharanpur Dehat seat, so seat membership is not confirmed.

statement_hindi: * गन्ना अभी भी मिलों तक पहुंच रहा है, खरीद चल रही है
statement_english: * Sugarcane mills are operating and the cane crop still has a buyer.
basis: Inference: ChiniMandi (May 2026) reports the Saharanpur protest over dues but names no mill and gives no figure, so mills operating is not stated in any source. Placeholder only, to be verified in the field. No source cited because none supports the claim.

statement_hindi: * रोजमर्रा का सामान गांव के आसपास ही मिल जाता है
statement_english: * Residents have a steady local market for daily needs.
basis: Inference: no source found. The 4pm.co.in trader quotes describe business as stalled and people travelling far daily, which points the other way. Placeholder only, to be verified in the field. No source cited because none supports the claim.

statement_hindi: * देहात में अब कुछ विकास कार्य पर ध्यान जा रहा है
statement_english: * Rural belt is seeing some local development attention.
basis: Inference: no source found that voters praise development here. The 4pm.co.in article says development is missing in Mohaddipur. Placeholder only, to be verified in the field. No source cited because none supports the claim.

statement_hindi: * इलाके में मंदिर और धाम पर श्रद्धालु आते हैं
statement_english: * Local temples and shrines draw devotees to the area.
basis: Inference: 4pm.co.in mentions the Shakumbhari Devi Shaktipeeth 'near the Jasmor area' only as background. Search results tie the Shakumbhari area to Behat (AC 1), and Jasmor is not confirmed as inside Saharanpur Dehat. No voter praise found. Placeholder only; verify seat membership or drop.

statement_hindi: मोहद्दीपुर गांव की सड़क एकदम टूटी है, निकलना मुश्किल है
statement_english: Mohaddipur village road is completely broken and hard to leave.
basis: Saharanpur Dehat-specific: a Mohaddipur villager says the village road is completely broken and leaving the village is difficult. The 4pm.co.in article is headlined as a report on Saharanpur Dehat; Mohaddipur is not in the Wikipedia area list, so seat membership rests on that article. One-sided political framing (opposition-leaning quotes, no government reply).

statement_hindi: बारिश में मोहद्दीपुर की सड़क पर घुटनों तक पानी भर जाता है
statement_english: Rain leaves knee-deep water on village roads in Mohaddipur.
basis: Saharanpur Dehat-specific: a Mohaddipur resident says that when it rains, water rises to the knees. Same article as the road complaint, so the same seat-membership and framing caveats apply.

statement_hindi: मोहद्दीपुर में विकास गायब है, प्रशासन बस टालमटोल करता है
statement_english: Mohaddipur residents say development is missing and officials only stall.
basis: Saharanpur Dehat-specific: the 4pm.co.in article has the section 'मोहद्दीपुर में विकास गायब' and a Mohaddipur resident says the administration only stalls and does no work. Same article and caveats as the road complaint.

statement_hindi: हाईवे की मिट्टी से हौजखेड़ी का पानी तीन साल से नहीं निकल रहा
statement_english: Highway soil has blocked village drainage in Hauzkheri for three years.
basis: District-level (Saharanpur): soil dumped on Delhi-Yamunotri SH-57 has blocked the Hauzkheri village drainage for about three years; a channel at khasra 343 is closed and water collects around homes and fields. The article gives no block or tehsil and does not name the Dehat seat, so placement in AC 4 is not confirmed.

statement_hindi: गन्ने का पिछले और इस सीजन का पैसा अब भी नहीं मिला
statement_english: Sugarcane dues from last season and this one are still unpaid.
basis: District-level (Saharanpur): farmers protested at the Saharanpur Sugarcane Department over outstanding dues from the current and previous crushing seasons; no amount stated. Officials asked for time until 21 May, then until 1 June 2026, per farmer representatives. No mill named.

statement_hindi: *दारुल उलूम की वजह से देवबंद पर हमें गर्व है
statement_english: *Because of Darul Uloom, we are proud of Deoband
basis: Inference: no source opened for the reputation claim. The Amar Ujala 23 Aug 2026 Deoband report does confirm that Darul Uloom is in Deoband (it names 'दारुल उलूम की सड़कें'), but says nothing about its reputation.

statement_hindi: सहारनपुर का खेल कॉलेज 2011 से अधूरा था, अब बन गया, अच्छा है
statement_english: Saharanpur's sports college, unfinished since 2011, is now built, and that is good
basis: District-level (Saharanpur city, not Deoband town), dated 1 July 2026: the college, 'pending since 2011', was completed; 80 seats reserved for athletes; 'Its academic session has started from 2026-27.' Free Press Journal, a national outlet.

statement_hindi: *देवबंद का बाज़ार दिनभर खुला रहता है, दुकानें चलती रहती हैं
statement_english: *Local bazaar and shops stay open and busy through the day
basis: Inference: no source opened for this claim; a general town-level impression, not verified.

statement_hindi: *दूर-दूर से छात्र यहाँ पढ़ने आते हैं, शिक्षा का नाम है
statement_english: *Students come from far away to study in Deoband's schools
basis: Inference: no source opened for this claim; linked to the Darul Uloom profile of the town, not verified.

statement_hindi: *दिल्ली से करीब 150 किलोमीटर, सड़क से आना-जाना संभव है
statement_english: *Town is about 150 km from Delhi, reachable by road
basis: Inference: the Wikipedia Deoband page gives the distance from Delhi (about 150 km); 'reachable by road' is not separately verified.

statement_hindi: चीनी मिलों पर गन्ना किसानों का बकाया था, पैसा कब मिलेगा?
statement_english: Sugar mills owed cane growers money, when will payment come?
basis: District-level (Saharanpur), dated 3 June 2021, verified: mills paid Rs 100.34 crore that day, Deoband mill's share Rs 19 crore, and 'जिले की शुगर मिलों पर अभी भी 630 करोड़ रुपये गन्ना मूल्य के बकाया हैं'. Names the Deoband mill, but the 2021 figure is old; no 2024-2026 Deoband mill dues report was found.

statement_hindi: बरसात में हर साल देवबंद की सड़कें-नाले पानी में डूब जाते हैं
statement_english: Every monsoon, Deoband's roads and drains go under water
basis: Deoband town, dated 23 Aug 2026, verified: about one hour of rain flooded main roads including Mohalla Nechalgarh, Bhayla Road, Ravidas Marg, Shikshak Nagar and roads near Darul Uloom; the government hospital on Railway Road had about 2.5 feet of water. Residents said it happens every year and blamed poor pre-monsoon drain cleaning ('बरसात से पहले नालों की उचित सफाई ... नहीं की जाती').

statement_hindi: गन्ने का भाव 600 रुपये क्विंटल हो, तभी खेती का गुज़ारा होगा
statement_english: Farmers want cane price of Rs 600 per quintal, or farming won't pay
basis: District-level (Saharanpur), dated 7 January 2023, verified: BKU (Verma) demanded 'गन्ना मूल्य 600 रुपये प्रति क्विंटल घोषित' in a memorandum to DM Akhilesh Singh. Not Deoband-town-specific; 2023, not 2024-2026.

statement_hindi: फैक्ट्रियों में बार-बार बिजली ट्रिप होती है, अलग फीडर कब लगेगा
statement_english: Factories in Deoband keep facing power tripping, when will a separate feeder come?
basis: Deoband industrial area, dated 21 Sep 2026, verified: Indian Industries Association entrepreneurs in Deoband submitted a memorandum for 'औद्योगिक क्षेत्र के लिए अलग से फीडर'; chapter chairman said factories' load is tied to a nearby colony's supply, so 'ट्रिपिंग की समस्या बनी रहती है'. Industry complaint, not household; household low-voltage complaints for Deoband were not found.

statement_hindi: *सड़क पर अतिक्रमण और दुकानों के आगे जाम रोज़ की परेशानी है
statement_english: *Encroachment and traffic jams on town roads are a daily trouble
basis: Inference: no Deoband-specific source found in 2024-2026 searches. Encroachment-related jam reports were from other UP towns (Siddharthnagar, Muzaffarnagar, Jalaun) and a Saharanpur city bridge jam (Mar 2025, Hindon bridge), not Deoband.

statement_hindi: रामपुर मनिहारन से दिल्ली तक बस और रेल मिल जाती है
statement_english: From Rampur Maniharan I can get a bus or train to Delhi
basis: Wikipedia (Rampur Maniharan town page, accessed 2026-10-12): 'situated 15 km from Saharanpur on the NH 709B and has bus and rail connections to Delhi.' Town-level, not a dated project.

statement_hindi: यहां इलाज की कई सुविधाएं मिल जाती हैं
statement_english: Many medical facilities are available here in town
basis: Wikipedia (Rampur Maniharan town page, accessed 2026-10-12): 'There are many medical facilities in this town.' No facilities are named and no quality or year is given; a general statement only.

statement_hindi: हम संगठित होकर ज्ञापन देकर अपनी बात अधिकारियों तक पहुंचा पाते हैं
statement_english: We organise and hand over memoranda, so our demands reach officials
basis: Saharanpur district-level: BKU Verma workers handed a memorandum addressed to the Governor to DM Akhilesh Singh (Amar Ujala, Sat 7 Jan 2023). Verified by fetch. Not AC-specific.

statement_hindi: * गन्ना यहाँ की नकदी फसल है, जो पास की मिल में बिक जाता है
statement_english: * Sugarcane is our cash crop, and it gets sold to the mill nearby
basis: Inference: not stated as a positive by any source. Context only: Royal Bulletin (5 Oct 2026) says the Gangnauli Bajaj mill owes Rs 88.51 crore of cane value for the 2025-26 season, so cane is supplied to a local mill. That does not show cane is the main cash crop.

statement_hindi: * मनरेगा से कुछ परिवारों को थोड़ा काम मिल जाता है
statement_english: * Some families get a few days of work under MGNREGA
basis: Inference: no source confirms MGNREGA work in this AC. The 2023 Saharanpur memorandum (Amar Ujala, 7 Jan 2023) only demanded that farming be linked with MGNREGA labour, which is a demand, not evidence the scheme operates.

statement_hindi: नगल की बजाज मिल पर हमारे गन्ने के करोड़ों रुपये बकाया हैं
statement_english: The Bajaj mill in Nagal still owes crores of rupees for our sugarcane
basis: Royal Bulletin (5 Oct 2026): DM Arvind Kumar Chauhan reviewed dues; the Bajaj group's Gangnauli mill owes Rs 88.51 crore for the 2025-26 season and the DM rebuked unit head R.B. Khokhar. Amar Ujala (6 Feb 2023) places Gangnauli in the Nagal area; the mill GM was arrested over Rs 21.56 crore dues and released on an affidavit to pay by 12 Feb. Wikipedia names Nagal as part of this AC, but does not name Gangnauli, so AC membership of the mill village is a field check item.

statement_hindi: * बारिश में सड़कें टूट जाती हैं और खेतों में पानी भर जाता है
statement_english: * When it rains, the roads break and the fields fill with water
basis: Inference: the only source found was a CropGPT aggregator summary (16 Jul 2026) about the Deoband region. Its original outlet could not be found, so the source was dropped. No Nagal or Rampur Maniharan road report was found in Hindi press.

statement_hindi: * सहकारी समितियों में यूरिया समय पर नहीं मिलता, फसल पर असर पड़ता है
statement_english: * Urea is not given on time at the cooperative societies, which hurts the crop
basis: Inference: no Saharanpur or Nagal urea report found. Regional context only: Amar Ujala reported urea shortages at cooperative societies in Shamli (May 2026) and Meerut (May 2026). The CropGPT source for the Deoband region was dropped because its original outlet could not be found.

statement_hindi: हमारी खड़ी फसल को नीलगाय और आवारा पशु नुकसान पहुंचाते हैं
statement_english: Nilgai and stray animals damage our standing crop
basis: Saharanpur district-level: BKU Verma's memorandum to DM Akhilesh Singh (Amar Ujala, 7 Jan 2023) demanded protection of crops from stray animals and nilgai. Verified by fetch. Dated 2023; no 2024-26 Saharanpur or AC report found, so persistence is not shown.

statement_hindi: हम चाहते हैं खेतों के लिए बिजली मुफ्त मिले
statement_english: We want free electricity for our fields
basis: Saharanpur district-level: the same BKU Verma memorandum (Amar Ujala, 7 Jan 2023) demanded free electricity for farmers. Verified by fetch. The memo does not say power is costly or cut in this AC, so no such claim is made here.

statement_hindi: गंगोह-नकुड़ में छह सड़कें पांच साल की गारंटी के साथ बनेंगी, अच्छा है
statement_english: It is good that six roads in Gangoh-Nakur will be built with a five-year guarantee
basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jan 2024): PWD plans six roads in Gangoh and Nakur at Rs 7.79 crore, with a five-year guarantee; tender process to start. Planned works; completion was not verified in this research.

statement_hindi: सीमा विस्तार हो तो पास के इलाकों को शहरी सुविधाएं मिल सकती हैं
statement_english: If the boundary is extended, nearby areas could get urban facilities
basis: Amar Ujala (3 Sep 2025): Gangoh and Nakur municipalities prepared boundary-expansion proposals, forwarded to the state after district approval; process starts only after state approval. Article says nearby areas could get urban facilities after expansion. Pending.

statement_hindi: गंगोह ब्लॉक में लापरवाह पंचायत सचिव पर सख्त कार्रवाई हुई, अच्छा है
statement_english: Strict action was taken against a careless panchayat secretary in Gangoh block, which is good
basis: Amar Ujala (18 Aug 2026): DM Arvind Kumar Chauhan suspended panchayat secretary Gaurav Sharma (posted at Khanpur Gurjar) after an inquiry; panchayat assistant Sabir ordered dismissed; FIRs ordered. The lapse concerned misuse of the civil registration (CRS) portal for death certificates, not roads or water. Administrative, not a resident complaint.

statement_hindi: प्रस्तावित शामली-अंबाला एक्सप्रेसवे गंगोह से होकर गुजरेगा
statement_english: The proposed Shamli-Ambala expressway will pass through Gangoh
basis: Wikipedia (Gangoh town page) states: 'Proposed Shamli Ambala six lane expressway will pass through Gangoh'. Proposal only; no date or construction status on the page. Undated.

statement_hindi: हमारे खेत उपजाऊ हैं, गेहूं, धान, गन्ना और आम खूब होते हैं
statement_english: Our fields are fertile, and wheat, rice, sugarcane and mangoes grow here in large amounts
basis: Wikipedia (Gangoh town page): soil described as 'fertile'; 'Wheat, rice, sugarcane, and mangoes are grown on a large scale every year.' General description, undated.

statement_hindi: बारिश में तार टूटा, गंगोह में 6-8 घंटे बिजली गुल रही
statement_english: The line broke in rain, and power in Gangoh was out for 6 to 8 hours
basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026): 11 kV line fault during rain near Vidyarthi Chowk, Bypass Road, Gangoh. Gangoh town and villages on the Jehra power house feed lost supply for about 6 to 8 hours; shops and homes affected. XEN Subodh Kumar said a team was sent to the spot. Residents demanded regular line inspection in the monsoon.

statement_hindi: टायर फैक्ट्री के धुएं से सांस लेना मुश्किल, बदबू से हम परेशान हैं
statement_english: Smoke from the tyre factory makes breathing hard, and the smell troubles us
basis: Kallarheri (Gangoh): residents say smoke reached nearby villages, making breathing hard and raising fears of illness; earlier complaints had been filed (Amar Ujala, 10 Oct 2026). The Pollution Control Board said the factory held permission and no pollution complaint had been received (Amar Ujala, 11 Oct 2026).

statement_hindi: धुएं के झगड़े में एक जान चली गई, यह हमारे गांव में हुआ
statement_english: One life was lost in the smoke dispute, and it happened in our village
basis: Kallarheri (Gangoh), night of 10 Oct 2026: villagers from Salarpura, Kallarheri and Sanauli went to demand closure over smoke; a clash followed. Factory owner Arbeen Chauhan (spelled Arbin in some copy) died during treatment; two men injured. Reports differ: two detained (10 Oct); three arrested and an FIR naming 11 people (11 Oct, which also says the family complaint names 20 people). Verify before use.

statement_hindi: सिंधली नदी की ज़मीन पर कब्जे हो गए, नदी लगभग खत्म हो गई
statement_english: Encroachments have taken over the Sindhali river land, and the river is almost gone
basis: Amar Ujala video (12 May 2025): the Sindhali river, now largely extinct, once flowed through 20 gram panchayats of Gangoh block; encroachments have taken its land. SDM marked river land at Alampur and Sukhedi; MGNREGA excavation planned; warned of strict action on re-encroachment. This is about encroachment, not flooding.

statement_hindi: * गन्ने का पैसा मिलों से समय पर नहीं मिलता
statement_english: * Sugarcane money does not come from the mills on time
basis: Inference: Wikipedia (Gangoh page) says sugarcane is grown on a large scale in the area, so cane payments are likely a farm concern. Searched 2025-2026 Hindi and English sources again; no Gangoh-specific report on cane dues was found (western UP dues reports exist but are not for Gangoh). Field verification needed.

statement_hindi: शामली मिल ने तीन किस्तों में हम किसानों को 32 करोड़ रुपये दिए
statement_english: The Shamli mill has given us farmers 32 crore rupees in three instalments
basis: Amar Ujala (6 Dec 2025, Meerut Bureau, 'other context' section) states that Shamli Cheeni Mill has released Rs 32 crore to farmers this season in three instalments (Hindi: 'तीन किस्तों में जारी कर चुकी है'). District-level, not Kairana-specific.

statement_hindi: कैराना में अवैध कॉलोनी तोड़ दी गई, प्लॉटिंग करने वालों पर सख्ती होगी
statement_english: An illegal colony in Kairana was demolished, and strict action on plotting will follow
basis: Amar Ujala (26 Sep 2025, Meerut Bureau) reports the Muzaffarnagar Development Authority demolished, on Thursday 25 Sep, a colony of about 60 bigha operating without an approved map near the Panipat-Khatima bypass in Kairana; the authority said the campaign will continue district-wide and strict action will follow against illegal colonies and plotting. No resident complaint is reported.

statement_hindi: जहानपुरा मारपीट के फरार आरोपी पुलिस ने पकड़े, कार्रवाई हुई
statement_english: Police caught the absconding accused in the Jahanpura clash, and action was taken
basis: Shamli Police press release dated 01.09.2025 (uppolice.gov.in PDF): on 24.08.2025 two parties attacked each other in village Jahanpura, under Thana Kairana; a case was registered against 16 named and some unknown persons; Kairana police arrested three absconding accused on 01.09.2025; a separate accused, Rashid, had been arrested and sent to jail on 27.08.2025. Incident-level, police action only. Police-station jurisdiction is cited; Jahanpura's Kairana AC membership is not confirmed.

statement_hindi: गन्ने की पहली किस्त समिति के ज़रिए हमारे खाते में आई
statement_english: The first cane instalment came into our bank accounts through the cane committee
basis: Amar Ujala (6 Dec 2025): Un Cheeni mill sent Rs 7.39 crore to farmers' accounts through the cane committee as the first instalment for six days of crushing (9-14 Nov), against Rs 21.09 crore calculated for that period. The positive is limited: the first instalment covers about a third of the amount calculated. District-level.

statement_hindi: * तूफ़ान थमते ही बिजली लौट आई
statement_english: * Power came back as soon as the storm stopped
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026, Shamli) says power supply was disrupted during the wind-and-rain storm and resumed once the rain stopped; two 33 kV lines (Adarsh Mandi, Kheri Karmu) were shut down. The source does not give outage duration or say supply was good in Kairana. District-level, unverified for the AC.

statement_hindi: गन्ने का पैसा मिल में अटका है, बच्चों की फीस कैसे भरें
statement_english: Our cane money is stuck in the mill, and how will we pay the children's fees?
basis: ChiniMandi (19 Jun 2026, Hindi original) gives a combined outstanding of Rs 339.65 crore owed by the Bhaisana (Budhana), Shamli, Thana Bhawan and Un mills, and says arranging children's fees for the new session is a major challenge for farmers. Figures verified against the original (the Ground News summary wrongly said 'Unnao'; the mill is 'Un'). Un town is listed in Kairana AC on Wikipedia, so the Un mill is counted as partly AC-linked; its exact location is not separately verified. Other mills are district-level. Amar Ujala (6 Dec 2025) says the Thana Bhawan mill still owed about Rs 95 crore of old and new dues.

statement_hindi: कैराना में आठ साल से सड़क-नाली नहीं बनी, गंदा पानी सड़कों पर है
statement_english: No road or drain has been built in Kairana for eight years, and dirty water is on the roads
basis: Amar Ujala (31 Jul 2026, datelined Kairana): mohalla Chhadiyan, beyond the meat plant on Kandhla Road, 300+ families. Residents say no road or drain has been built for eight years; dirty water from homes fills the roads and potholes; complaints to the Nagar Palika went unresolved. The Nagar Palika Kairana executive officer said a budget would be passed soon. Kairana-specific (town, in AC).

statement_hindi: 20 सितंबर को कैराना में छह घंटे बिजली गई, पानी भी बंद रहा
statement_english: On 20 September, Kairana had no power for six hours, and water also stopped
basis: Amar Ujala (21 Sep 2026, Shamli): supply was off for about six hours on Sunday 20 Sep while a 33/11 kV line from the Shamli Bypass substation was replaced; an official said some lines were badly worn and faulting repeatedly. Municipal drinking-water supply also stopped during the outage. Kairana town-specific.

statement_hindi: आंधी-बारिश में बिजली बंद रही, हमारी खड़ी धान की फसल बिछ गई
statement_english: Storm cut the power, and our standing paddy crop was flattened
basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026, Shamli): wind and hail flattened ripe standing paddy; waterlogging put urad, potato, cauliflower and newly planted garlic at risk; power supply was disrupted with two 33 kV lines switched off. Covers Thanabhawan, Jalalabad, Oon and Jhinjhana, not Kairana itself. District-level; Oon (Un) is named but the report is not a Kairana-town report.

statement_hindi: जहानपुरा में वॉलीबॉल पर झगड़े में फायरिंग हुई, पांच लोग घायल
statement_english: In Jahanpura, a volleyball quarrel led to firing, and five people were injured
basis: Amar Ujala (26 May 2024): late on Saturday night a volleyball-game dispute in Jahanpura village in the Kairana area led to firing by one side; five people, including two women, were injured. Shamli Police's 2025 release also places Jahanpura under Thana Kairana. Jahanpura's Kairana AC membership is not confirmed, so this is not counted as AC-specific. 2024 incident.

statement_hindi: थानाभवन-चरथावल मार्ग का चौड़ीकरण शुरू हो गया है, राहत मिल सकती है
statement_english: Widening of the Thanabhawan-Charthawal road has started, so relief may come
basis: Amar Ujala (22 Jun 2026, Shamli dateline): PWD executive engineer confirms widening of the Thanabhawan-Charthawal-Muzaffarnagar road from 7 m to 10 m has started, estimated cost Rs 15 crore. This is work in progress, not a completed project. The road name is Thanabhawan-specific; the article does not say the whole stretch lies inside this AC.

statement_hindi: थानाभवन की पांच सड़कों का पैसा आ गया, टेंडर अभी बाकी है
statement_english: Money has come for five Thanabhawan roads, but tenders are still pending
basis: Amar Ujala (28 Aug 2026, Shamli): government released funds for five roads in Thana Bhawan on the local MLA's proposal, for FY 2026-27. Roads named include Tapraana-Jhijhana (new construction), Bantikheda (new construction), and Gohrpur-Kudana link road. Article gives no amount for these five; tenders not yet issued.

statement_hindi: श्मशान घाट की सड़क का टेंडर हो गया, काम का इंतजार है
statement_english: The cremation-ground road tender is done, and we are waiting for the work
basis: Nayan Jagriti (page last updated 23 Aug 2026; status as of 22 Aug 2026): tender process for the Thanabhawan cremation-ground road was completed about a year earlier and a contractor was selected, but no work order has been issued. This is only a process positive; construction has not begun.

statement_hindi: डीएम ने थानाभवन मिल को बकाया चुकाने की चेतावनी दी, यह सही है
statement_english: The DM has warned the Thanabhawan mill to clear the pending dues, which is right
basis: Amar Ujala (29 Sep 2026): DM Alok Yadav expressed displeasure at the Rs 81.37 crore cane price payment still pending at Thanabhawan mill and said strict action would follow if negligence continued. This is district administration action, not a completed fix on the ground.

statement_hindi: * किसान दिवस पर हम अपनी समस्याएं अधिकारियों के सामने रख सकते हैं
statement_english: * At Kisan Diwas we can put our problems directly before officials
basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (17 Sep 2026) reports the Shamli district Kisan Diwas (held Wednesday, 16 Sep) where farmers raised Thanabhawan mill dues, stray cattle, soil mining and power line issues in front of officials. The forum exists; the article does not show any outcome. District-level, not AC-specific.

statement_hindi: थानाभवन मिल ने अभी तक हमारा गन्ना मूल्य बकाया नहीं दिया है
statement_english: Thanabhawan mill still hasn't paid our sugarcane dues
basis: Amar Ujala (29 Sep 2026): review found Rs 81.37 crore cane price payment still pending at Thanabhawan sugar mill for the 2025-26 crushing season. Amar Ujala (17 Sep 2026): BKU youth district president Prabhat Malik says Thanabhawan mill has not paid farmers' dues.

statement_hindi: आवारा पशु फसल उजाड़ रहे हैं, रातभर खेत की रखवाली करनी पड़ती है
statement_english: Stray animals are ruining crops, and we have to guard the fields all night
basis: Amar Ujala (7 Jun 2026), Thanabhawan dateline: stray animals damage paddy, sugarcane, maize, sorghum, green fodder and vegetables in Nozal, Hasanpur, Khanpur, Chandenamal and surrounding villages. Farmers have to keep watch in their fields all night. Thanabhawan dateline is the AC-level link.

statement_hindi: श्मशान घाट का रास्ता बारिश में कीचड़ से भरा, सड़क नहीं बनी
statement_english: The cremation-ground road turns to mud in rain, and still hasn't been built
basis: Nayan Jagriti (updated 23 Aug 2026): the Thanabhawan cremation-ground road (ward 2, Nabipura) becomes waterlogged and muddy in rain, and funeral processions must pass through it. Tender completed about a year earlier, but construction has not started and no work order was issued. The Nagar Panchayat EO did not take the reporter's calls.

statement_hindi: जलालाबाद में सड़कों, गलियों और सब्जी के खेतों में पानी भर गया
statement_english: Water filled the roads, lanes and vegetable fields in Jalalabad
basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026, Shamli dateline, Samvad agency): streets and lanes in Jalalabad's localities were flooded after an hour of rain, and vegetable fields there were waterlogged. Jalalabad is a nagar panchayat in Shamli tehsil and part of this AC per Wikipedia AC page.

statement_hindi: तेज हवा-बारिश से हमारी पकी धान की फसल बिछ गई
statement_english: Strong wind and rain flattened our ripe paddy crop in the fields
basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026, Shamli dateline): rain with strong winds flattened standing ripe paddy in fields, and hail occurred in the Thanabhawan area. The flattening is reported for the Shamli report generally; only the hail is named for Thanabhawan, so this is weakly AC-specific.

statement_hindi: शामली मिल ने तीन किस्तों में हम किसानों को 32 करोड़ रुपये दिए
statement_english: The Shamli mill has given us farmers 32 crore rupees in three instalments
basis: District-level (Shamli chini mill; mill location within AC not separately verified). Source states: "शामली चीनी मिल नए पेराई सत्र में किसानों के 32 करोड़ रुपये तीन किस्तों में जारी कर चुकी है" (2025-26 season, article dated 6 Dec 2025). Verified by fetching www.amarujala.com.

statement_hindi: बिजली बिल राहत योजना शामली के 45 हजार उपभोक्ताओं के लिए आई थी
statement_english: A power bill relief scheme came for about 45,000 consumers in Shamli district
basis: District-level. Article (18 Nov 2025) says the UP Power Corporation bill relief scheme begins 1 Dec and runs to 28 Feb 2026, covering about 45,000 domestic and commercial consumers in Shamli district. Scheme has already ended; positive is historical, not current.

statement_hindi: भैंसवाल अंडरपास बन रहा है, शहर के जाम से राहत की उम्मीद है
statement_english: The Bhainswal underpass is being built, and we hope for relief from city jams
basis: Shamli city (district HQ link). Article (6 Apr 2026): underpass work by Northern Railway contractor for three months; "भैंसवाल मिनी बाईपास का अंडरपास जून माह में चालू हो जाएगा"; "शहर के जाम से छुटकारा मिलेगा"; PWD Shamli released funds. Completion or opening after June 2026 not confirmed.

statement_hindi: मेरठ-करनाल हाईवे के काबड़ौत पुल की मरम्मत आखिरी चरण में है
statement_english: Repairs on the Kabaudh bridge on the Meerut-Karnal highway are in the final stage
basis: District-level (Meerut-Karnal highway, Shamli district; AC location not verified). PWD Executive Engineer said the "काबड़ौत पुल की मरम्मत अंतिम चरण में है" with one lane closed, per the DISHA meeting report (meeting 26 Nov 2025, article 27 Nov 2025).

statement_hindi: केंद्रीय विद्यालय की नई जगह खोजी जा रही है, अस्थायी स्कूल प्रस्तावित
statement_english: A new site for the Kendriya Vidyalaya is being searched for, and a temporary school is proposed
basis: District-level (Shamli). DISHA report (27 Nov 2025): "विद्यालय के लिए नई भूमि तलाश की जा रही है, जिसका कार्य एक माह में पूरा कर लिया जाएगा"; temporary school at VV Inter College proposed. Still a proposal; no completion reported.

statement_hindi: बिल जमा कर दिया, फिर भी स्मार्ट मीटर से बिजली नहीं आई
statement_english: We paid the bill, but power did not come back from the smart meter
basis: AC-specific (Shamli city, Shamli tehsil fully in AC 10). Article (published 29 Mar 2026) reports that on a Saturday (28 Mar 2026, date inferred from publication date) hundreds of homes lost power via smart meters; at City Bijlighar consumers said they paid dues but supply was not restored; some households without power 2-3 days (consumers' claim). SE Virendra Singh said disconnection is for non-recharged meters.

statement_hindi: बारिश में वर्मा मार्केट, मिल रोड और बड़ा बाजार में पानी भर गया
statement_english: In rain, water fills Verma Market, Mill Road and Bada Bazar
basis: AC-specific (Shamli town markets). On Tue 4 Aug 2026 rain waterlogged "वर्मा मार्केट, मिल रोड और बड़ा बाजार समेत कई इलाकों"; pedestrians and drivers faced trouble. Video report; no official or resident quotes in the report.

statement_hindi: जल जीवन मिशन की पाइपलाइन से कांधला, आल्दी की सड़कें टूटीं, शिकायत हुई
statement_english: Roads in Kandhla and Aldi were broken by Jal Jeevan Mission pipeline work, and complaints were raised
basis: AC-specific: Kandhla (Kandhala) and Aldi (Aaldi) are both listed in the Shamli AC 10 area on the Wikipedia AC page (Kairana tehsil). DISHA report (27 Nov 2025): an MLC and MLA disputed the department's claim of 106 roads repaired; Kandhla and Kasaupur roads cited; a person at the meeting confirmed no repair in Budhpura and Aldi; Kairana MP Iqra Hasan ordered immediate repair and warned of action if no improvement by the April DISHA meeting. Budhpura is not placed in AC 10 and is not used in the English line.

statement_hindi: कांधला सीएचसी के वायरल वीडियो पर कार्रवाई की बात उठी
statement_english: At a meeting, action was raised over a viral video of the Kandhla CHC
basis: AC-specific: Kandhla (Kandhala) is listed among AC 10 areas on the Wikipedia Shamli AC page. DISHA report (27 Nov 2025) lists "कांधला सीएचसी के वायरल वीडियो पर कार्रवाई" among issues raised; no further detail in the report, so the English line states only that action was raised.

statement_hindi: जिला अस्पताल में सर्वर डाउन, दो घंटे जांच रिपोर्ट नहीं मिली, मरीज परेशान
statement_english: Server down at the district hospital, no test reports for two hours, and patients were troubled
basis: AC-specific (Shamli district hospital, Shamli town; Shamli tehsil fully in AC 10). Article (Fri 10 Apr 2026): CBC machine repaired, but on Thursday (9 Apr 2026) server down meant reports could not be issued; a crowd of patients waited about two hours. CMS Dr. Kishor Kumar Ahuja said he had not been informed of the outage.

statement_hindi: लुहसाना में गन्ना खरीद केंद्र मंजूर, अब दूर नहीं जाना पड़ेगा
statement_english: A cane purchase centre approved at Luhsana means no long trip to deliver cane
basis: ChiniMandi (24 Oct 2025): a new purchasing centre 'has been approved for the village of Luhsana' to address disputes in the Bhainsana region near the Budhana sugar mill; the source calls it 'a more accessible point for sugarcane supply'. Approved, not confirmed as operating.

statement_hindi: लुहसाना समेत सात गांवों की नई डिस्पेंसरी मंजूर हो गई है
statement_english: A new dispensary is sanctioned for seven Budhana villages, Luhsana included
basis: Royal Bulletin (4 Oct 2026): administrative sanction received for new medical dispensaries in seven Budhana villages (Jaitpur, Luhsana, Mandwara, Jogiyakheda, Vigyana, Madinpur, Jaula). Construction 'will start very soon' and the dispensaries will open later; none is open yet. Approval stage, not a delivered facility.

statement_hindi: मिल ने अब भुगतान की तारीखें तय कर दी हैं
statement_english: The mill has now fixed payment dates for cane dues
basis: ChiniMandi (12 Apr 2025, district review meeting): minister Anil Kumar criticised the Budhana mill's 'poor payment record' and 'a payment schedule has now been established', with strict action promised if the timeline is missed. Mill named; district-level meeting. Schedule is set, but compliance is not shown in this source.

statement_hindi: बुढ़ाना से मुजफ्फरनगर के लिए रोडवेज बस की सुविधा है
statement_english: There is a roadways bus service from Budhana to Muzaffarnagar
basis: Navbharat Live (9 Sep 2026) describes 'a roadways bus travelling from Budhana towards Muzaffarnagar' (बुढ़ाना से मुजफ्फरनगर की ओर जा रही रोडवेज बस). Shows the service runs on this road; frequency and reliability are not stated.

statement_hindi: जिले की मिलों ने ज़्यादातर गन्ना बकाया चुकाया है
statement_english: Most of the district's cane dues across eight mills have been paid
basis: ChiniMandi (12 Apr 2025): across the district's eight mills, payments of Rs 2,875.16 crore had been made against Rs 3,150.39 crore total, 91.26 percent. District-level figure, not Budhana-only, and dates from April 2025.

statement_hindi: भैंसाना मिल का गन्ना बकाया अटका है, फीस और शादी कैसे चलाएं
statement_english: Bhaisana mill's cane dues are stuck, so how do we manage fees and weddings
basis: ChiniMandi (19 Jun 2026) as summarised by Ground News: 'The Bhaisana Sugar Mill in Budhana, along with sugar mills in Shamli, Thana Bhawan, and Unnao, owe farmers a total of ₹339.65 crore'. The excerpt gives no per-mill split. Farmers face wedding season and school-fee costs for the new academic session. Original ChiniMandi article not found; the Ground News page is an aggregator.

statement_hindi: बुढ़ाना-मुजफ्फरनगर रोड पर बसों की रेस में पांच लोग मर गए
statement_english: Five people died when buses raced on the Budhana-Muzaffarnagar road
basis: Navbharat Live (9 Sep 2026): in the Budhana area near Bhaisana village, a roadways bus hit two motorcycles and five people died, including a three-year-old girl. Eyewitnesses said two buses were racing for passengers and one tried to overtake; the driver fled. Police said no written complaint (तहरीर) had been received yet.

statement_hindi: भैंसाना की तंग गलियों में गन्ना सप्लाई पर अक्सर झगड़े होते हैं
statement_english: Narrow lanes in Bhainsana often lead to disputes over cane supply
basis: ChiniMandi (24 Oct 2025): 'ongoing disputes in the Bhainsana region near the Budhana sugar mill'; 'narrow lanes ... often led to supply-related conflicts'. Source spells the village 'Bhainsana'; Navbharat Live spells it 'Bhaisana'.

statement_hindi: तबलशाह रोड जर्जर है, अतिक्रमण से दिन भर जाम लगता है
statement_english: Tabalshah Road is broken, and encroachment causes jams all day
basis: Amar Ujala (25 Feb 2026): Tabalshah Road in Kidwai Nagar, Muzaffarnagar city, is 'very dilapidated' and encroachment causes all-day jams; a road-construction tender has been issued and a Rs 79 lakh budget approved. City-level, not Budhana AC, so not counted as an AC-specific negative.

statement_hindi: मुजफ्फरनगर के कई इलाकों में बिजली बार-बार जाती है, घंटों सप्लाई बंद
statement_english: Power in several Muzaffarnagar areas keeps going off for hours
basis: Dainik Bhaskar (27 Jul 2026) via Ground News, district-level (Muzaffarnagar city, 'several key areas'): supply disrupted for nearly a week, coming on for a few minutes and then off for hours. Budhana is not named in the source, so this is not confirmed for Budhana. Original Bhaskar article not found.

statement_hindi: चरथावल नगर पंचायत में नई पेयजल योजना बन गई है
statement_english: Charthawal Nagar Panchayat's new drinking water scheme is complete
basis: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath inaugurated the drinking water reorganisation scheme of Nagar Panchayat Charthawal among 423 projects worth over Rs 951 crore in Muzaffarnagar (Webdunia Hindi, updated 13 Apr 2026). The same list is in Prokerala (aggregator, 14 Apr 2026). This is a government completion; the sources do not report voters' views on it.

statement_hindi: *हाईवे पास होने से बघरा से मंडी-शहर जाना आसान है
statement_english: *Highway access makes it easy to reach mandis and towns from Baghra
basis: Inference: no source found on voters' views of roads or access. The Panipat-Khatima highway runs past the Baghra bypass (Amar Ujala, 2025-10-01, see negative 4), so access is a plausible strength but is unverified.

statement_hindi: *गन्ने से नकदी मिलती है, मिलें गन्ना खरीदती हैं
statement_english: *Sugarcane is a cash crop here, and mills in the area take it
basis: Inference: sugarcane is the main cash crop in the district (Amar Ujala, 2025-12-05, district-level), but no source says voters see it as a positive. Dues are a complaint (negative 1).

statement_hindi: *बघरा की सहकारी समिति से खाद मिलने का सहारा अब भी है
statement_english: *The cooperative committee at Baghra still supplies fertiliser to farmers
basis: Inference: the Baghra committee is a working distribution point (Amar Ujala, 2025-06-27 and 2025-07-04), and its supply is also the main complaint (negatives 2 and 3). Value as a positive is unverified.

statement_hindi: *चरथावल के बाजार में रोजमर्रा का सामान पास में मिल जाता है
statement_english: *Charthawal's market gives daily essentials close to home
basis: Inference: Charthawal is a Nagar Panchayat and development block (Wikipedia, Charthawal Assembly constituency). No source on market access was found.

statement_hindi: गन्ने का बकाया मिलों पर अटका है, और भाव भी कम है
statement_english: Sugarcane dues are still stuck with the mills, and the price is too low
basis: District-level, not AC-specific. Amar Ujala (Muzaffarnagar, 5 Dec 2025) reports that Bajaj group's 14 mills owe farmers more than Rs 100 crore, and that the cane price is inadequate (UP Rs 400/quintal, against Haryana Rs 415 and Punjab Rs 416). The article attributes these points to SP MP Harendra Malik.

statement_hindi: बघरा में यूरिया नहीं मिलती, किसान खाली हाथ लौटते हैं
statement_english: At Baghra, urea is not available, and farmers go home empty-handed
basis: AC-specific. Amar Ujala video report (Dimple Sirohi, 27 Jun 2025) describes a ruckus at Sadhan Sahkari Samiti, Baghra, where farmers from six villages returned without urea. The farmers' allegation of unfair distribution is their claim, not verified.

statement_hindi: बघरा समिति पर खाद की लंबी लाइन, कर्मचारी देर से आते हैं
statement_english: At the Baghra committee, fertiliser queues are long and staff arrive late
basis: AC-specific. Amar Ujala video report (4 Jul 2025) says a long queue of farmers formed at the Baghra cooperative committee on the Panipat-Khatima highway, staff arrived late, and urea distribution began only in the afternoon. Farmers' complaint.

statement_hindi: बघरा बाईपास पर खड़े ट्रक से कार टकराई, छह लोगों की जान गई
statement_english: On the Baghra bypass, a car hit a parked truck and six people died
basis: AC-specific location. Amar Ujala (1 Oct 2025) reports a car ran into a truck parked at a dhaba on the Baghra bypass of the Panipat-Khatima highway; six people died and one was injured.

statement_hindi: *आवारा पशु फसल खा जाते हैं, खेत की रखवाली मुश्किल है
statement_english: *Stray cattle eat the crop and farmers cannot protect their fields
basis: Inference: stray cattle is a common farm complaint in western UP, but no source specific to Charthawal or Muzaffarnagar was found in two searches (Hindi and English). Field check needed.

statement_hindi: पुरकाजी में खुले में शौच नहीं दिखता, सामुदायिक शौचालय ठीक हैं
statement_english: In Purkazi, open defecation is not seen and community toilets are fine
basis: Amar Ujala (Meerut bureau, 23 Feb 2019), verified: Purkazi nagar panchayat declared ODF Plus in the central sanitation survey; a Quality Council of Delhi team inspected on 16 January and found no open defecation; community toilet arrangements were better. Dated 2019, so may be stale.

statement_hindi: * दिल्ली-देहरादून हाईवे (NH 58) पर होने से दिल्ली और हरिद्वार आना-जाना आसान है
statement_english: * Being on the Delhi-Dehradun highway (NH 58) makes travel to Delhi and Haridwar easier
basis: Inference: Wikipedia (Purkazi), verified, states the town is on NH 58, the Delhi-Dehradun highway, and shares a border with Haridwar district. No voter statement or appreciation found for this AC; this is a guess about what voters value.

statement_hindi: * गन्ना यहाँ की मुख्य फसल है
statement_english: * Sugarcane is the main crop here
basis: Inference: Tribune (1 Mar 2021, Muzaffarnagar district-level), verified, describes sugarcane as the main grievance of farmers and gives per-hectare cost figures. It does not say sugarcane is the main crop of Purkazi or that it is a positive. Placeholder needing a field check.

statement_hindi: * हरिद्वार से नज़दीकी से किसानों और व्यापारियों को बड़ा बाज़ार मिलता है
statement_english: * Being close to Haridwar gives local farmers and traders access to a wider market
basis: Inference: Wikipedia (Purkazi), verified, states the town borders Haridwar district in Uttarakhand. No source found on market access or voter views of it. Placeholder needing a field check.

statement_hindi: * कस्बे में ज़रूरी सुविधाएं ठीक-ठाक चल रही हैं
statement_english: * Essential facilities in the town are running reasonably well
basis: Inference: the only Purkazi-specific source found (Amar Ujala 2019, verified) covers sanitation only. No source on current water, roads or power in the town was found in about 10 searches. Weak placeholder that must be checked in the field.

statement_hindi: चीनी मिलों ने पिछले सीज़न का बकाया नहीं चुकाया, किसान इंतज़ार में
statement_english: Sugar mills have not cleared last season's cane dues, and farmers are left waiting
basis: Tribune (dateline Muzaffarnagar, 28 Feb; published 1 Mar 2021), verified, district-level: farmers say several sugar mills have not cleared last season's dues; one farmer cited a delay of over a year. The article does not name Purkazi. Dated 2021; no newer Purkazi-specific source found.

statement_hindi: मखियाली पावर हाउस पर लोड बहुत, सिंचाई की बिजली देर से आती है
statement_english: The Makhiyali power house is overloaded, so irrigation power comes late
basis: Amar Ujala (video report, 20 Mar 2025, Muzaffarnagar district panchayat hall, Kisan Diwas), verified: farmers said the Makhiyali power house has been overloaded for three years, so irrigation power comes late. District-level. Makhiyali is not among the AC areas listed on the Purqazi AC Wikipedia page, so AC membership is unconfirmed; field check needed.

statement_hindi: कई सीज़न से गन्ने का भाव नहीं बढ़ा, खेती का खर्च बढ़ रहा है
statement_english: Cane prices have not risen for several seasons while farming costs keep rising
basis: Tribune (1 Mar 2021), verified, Muzaffarnagar district-level: a farmer says cane prices have not been raised for several seasons; FRP rose from Rs 255 (2017-18) to Rs 285 (2020-21) per quintal; a farmer spends more than Rs 2 lakh per hectare per season. Not Purkazi-specific.

statement_hindi: पुरकाजी का सूली वाला बाग राष्ट्रीय शहीद स्थल घोषित हो, यही मांग है
statement_english: Residents want Purkazi's Suliwala Bagh, site of 1857 killings, declared a national martyrs' site
basis: Wikipedia (Purkazi), verified: 'The citizens of Purkazi are demanding Suliwala Bagh to be declared as a National Shaheed Sthal'; the page describes the 1857 killing of 500 freedom fighters there. The page cites a Hindi headline dated 26 Jan 2019 attributing the demand to BKU. Town-specific, but a 2019 demand and not a service grievance; current status not found, so it may be stale and weak for vote impact. Replaces the 2021 Tribune fertiliser/cattle item, which was not Purkazi-specific and whose Hindi was too long.

statement_hindi: ओवरलोड गन्ने की गाड़ियों से हादसे, किसान अफ़सरों को दोषी मानते हैं
statement_english: Overloaded sugarcane trucks cause accidents, and farmers blame officials for them
basis: Amar Ujala (video report, 20 Mar 2025, Muzaffarnagar district panchayat hall), verified: farmers blamed officials for accidents involving overloaded sugarcane vehicles; the Additional DM promised to resolve the problem. District-level; no Purkazi road or accident is named.

statement_hindi: तबलशाह रोड का 79 लाख बजट मंज़ूर, टेंडर भी निकल गया
statement_english: Talashah Road's Rs 79 lakh budget is sanctioned and the tender is already out.
basis: Amar Ujala (25 Feb 2026): the Municipal Board approved Rs 79 lakh for Talashah Road in Kidwai Nagar (between Municipal Wards 25 and 45); JE Kapil Kumar said the tender has been issued and work will start soon. Not yet completed.

statement_hindi: कई कॉलोनियों की सड़कों का बजट आ गया, काम अभी बाकी है
statement_english: Budgets have come for roads in several city colonies, but the work is still pending.
basis: Amar Ujala (20 Aug 2025, Meerut bureau): MDA budget released for roads in Purani State Bank Colony (Rs 26 lakh), Vishnu Vihar Phase 1 (Rs 21 lakh), Amba Vihar (Rs 21 and 16 lakh) and Numaish Camp (Rs 13 lakh); construction starts after tender. Planned, not completed. Colony-level, Muzaffarnagar city.

statement_hindi: नया सैटेलाइट बस अड्डा मंज़ूर हो गया, अब बजट का इंतजार है
statement_english: A new satellite bus stand has been approved, but construction waits for funds.
basis: Amar Ujala (2 May 2026, Muzaffarnagar dateline): CM Yogi Adityanath approved a satellite bus stand on a PPP model; construction will not start until funds are released. Proposed site is outside the city near Transport Nagar on the Delhi-Dehradun highway; proposal pending at corporation HQ for about four years. Approval only, not completed.

statement_hindi: स्टेशन रोड से अवैध खोखा हटा दिया गया, अतिक्रमण पर कार्रवाई हुई
statement_english: On station road, an illegal kiosk was removed and encroachment action was taken.
basis: Amar Ujala (13 Mar 2026): municipal anti-encroachment drive on Railway Station Road; an illegal kiosk near Railway Station Gate No. 2 was removed with a JCB after a civil court ruling in the municipality's favour (EO Dr. Pragya Singh). Other encroaching shopkeepers on the road also faced action.

statement_hindi: किसान दिवस पर अफसरों ने हमारी बात सुनी
statement_english: At Kisan Diwas, officials heard our complaints.
basis: Amar Ujala video (20 Mar 2025): at Kisan Diwas in the district panchayat hall, Additional DM (Administration) Narendra Bahadur Singh promised to resolve the power and overloaded cane-vehicle issues. Assurance only; no action or deadline reported. District-level.

statement_hindi: शहर में बिजली कुछ मिनट आती है, फिर घंटों गायब रहती है
statement_english: Power comes on for a few minutes in the city, then vanishes for hours.
basis: Dainik Bhaskar via Ground News (27 Jul 2026, aggregator; original paywalled): power disrupted for nearly a week in several key areas of the city; 'The supply would come on for a few minutes and then disappear for hours'. No neighbourhoods named. Corroborated by Navbharat Live video (29 Jun 2026) on unannounced cuts across Muzaffarnagar in heat; it names no locality and is district-level.

statement_hindi: तबलशाह रोड जर्जर है, अतिक्रमण से दिन भर जाम लगता है
statement_english: Talashah Road is broken, and encroachment causes jams all day.
basis: Amar Ujala (25 Feb 2026): Talashah Road in Kidwai Nagar is in a 'जर्जर अवस्था'; encroachment causes jams through the day; residents staged a sit-in on the road and demanded rebuilding and removal of encroachments. City-specific.

statement_hindi: तेज बारिश में शहर के कई इलाकों में जलभराव, कांवड़ियों की राह मुश्किल
statement_english: Heavy rain waterlogs many city areas and makes the Kanwar route hard to walk.
basis: Amar Ujala video (4 Aug 2026): heavy rain waterlogged 'शहर के कई इलाकों' in the city; the Kanwar route at Bajheri, Pinna Bypass and Shiv Chowk was hard for pilgrims, some walking through standing water. Drain condition not discussed in the report. City-specific.

statement_hindi: बस अड्डे के पास अक्सर जाम लगता है, नया बस अड्डा अटका है
statement_english: Jams build up near the city bus stand, and the new bus stand is stuck for years.
basis: Amar Ujala (2 May 2026): 'इन बसों के कारण बस अड्डे के निकट अधिकतर जाम लगा रहता है'; the roadways stand near Prakash Chowk in the city centre handles about 750 buses a day; the satellite-stand proposal has been pending at corporation HQ for about four years. City-specific.

statement_hindi: मखियाली बिजलीघर ओवरलोड है, सिंचाई की बिजली समय पर नहीं मिलती
statement_english: The Makhiyali power house is overloaded, so our irrigation power comes late.
basis: Amar Ujala video (20 Mar 2025, Kisan Diwas): farmers said the Makhiyali power house has been overloaded for three years, so irrigation power does not come on time. Makhiyali is listed in the AC 14 extent on Wikipedia. Source is from 2025; persistence not confirmed.

statement_hindi: हमारी त्रिवेणी चीनी मिल एशिया में सबसे बड़ी है
statement_english: Our Triveni sugar mill is the largest in Asia
basis: Wikipedia (Khatauli town page), verified: Khatauli's Triveni sugar mill is 'the largest in Asia in terms of production and storage capacity', operating since 1933. This is a source fact, not a voter quote.

statement_hindi: हमें हाईवे-58 का फायदा मिलता है, व्यापार का अहम रास्ता है
statement_english: We benefit from NH-58, an important route for trade
basis: Wikipedia (Khatauli town page), verified: 'Khatauli lies on the National Highway 58 which is an important route for trade and commerce.' Recorded as a fact, not a voiced appreciation.

statement_hindi: खतौली से जीवना तक 8.3 किमी सड़क बन रही है
statement_english: The 8.3 km Khatauli-Jeevna road is being built
basis: Amar Ujala (Meerut bureau, dateline Khatauli), 10 Nov 2022, verified: PWD XEN Neeraj Kumar said the road is 8.3 km, costs Rs 436.53 crore and runs from Khatauli to Jeevana. This is a 2022 report; current completion status was not found.

statement_hindi: खतौली से दिल्ली-सहारनपुर की रेल मिल जाती है
statement_english: Trains to Delhi and Saharanpur are available from Khatauli
basis: Wikipedia (Khatauli town page), verified: 'The town lies on Delhi - Saharanpur (via Meerut) railway route.' Recorded as a fact, not a voiced appreciation.

statement_hindi: खतौली 2007 से तहसील है, दिल्ली से लगभग 100 किलोमीटर दूर
statement_english: Khatauli has been a tehsil since 2007 and is about 100 km from Delhi
basis: Wikipedia (Khatauli town page), verified: 'Khatauli was declared as Tehsil in 2007'; 'situated 100 km away from the national capital New Delhi'. Recorded as a fact; weakest positive, no voter appreciation found.

statement_hindi: गन्ने का बकाया भुगतान अटका है, मिलें जल्द पैसा दें
statement_english: Cane dues remain unpaid and farmers want the mills to pay quickly
basis: Royal Bulletin (Muzaffarnagar), 8 Oct 2026, verified: farmers of the BKU protested at the IPL sugar mill, Rohana Kalan, Muzaffarnagar, demanding that outstanding cane payment be made 'without delay' and late-payment interest be paid. No amount is stated. District-level: the mill is not in Khatauli and Khatauli is not named.

statement_hindi: बिजली घंटों गायब रहती है, कुछ मिनट आकर फिर चली जाती है
statement_english: Power vanishes for hours, coming back only for a few minutes at a time
basis: Dainik Bhaskar via Ground News (aggregator), 27 July 2026, verified from the aggregator page: power supply disrupted for nearly a week; 'The supply would come on for a few minutes and then disappear for hours.' District-level (Muzaffarnagar); Khatauli is not named. The original bhaskar.com article could not be opened.

statement_hindi: खतौली में टैक्स विवाद पर सफाई कर्मी हड़ताल पर, पुलिस ने लाठी चलाई
statement_english: In Khatauli, sanitation workers struck over a tax dispute, and police used lathis
basis: Patrika, published and updated 5 May 2026, verified: in the Khatauli nagar palika area, about 50 quintals of garbage were dumped outside a Congress leader's house over about Rs 4 lakh of unpaid tax on four shops; sanitation workers stopped work and announced a strike; police lathi-charged the protesters.

statement_hindi: भैंसी नाले का पुल जर्जर, फिर भी सैकड़ों ग्रामीण और वाहन गुज़रते हैं
statement_english: The old bridge over the Bhainsi nala on the Khatauli-Nawala road is dilapidated, yet hundreds of villagers and vehicles cross it daily
basis: Amar Ujala, 10 Nov 2022, verified: the bridge over the Bhainsi nala on the Khatauli-Nawala road is in a dilapidated state and kept in use with iron girders; besides farmers taking cane to the mill, hundreds of villagers and vehicles cross it daily. Road work started while the bridge work was stalled pending a tender. This is a 2022 report; current status was not found.

statement_hindi: रजवाहे की सफाई हुई, कीचड़ वहीं छोड़ दिया, जलभराव और बदबू
statement_english: The distributary was cleaned, but silt was left there, causing waterlogging and a bad smell
basis: Patrika, published 5 Nov 2025, verified: the rajwaha (distributary) was cleaned in Khatauli, but the removed silt and mud were left there, which caused waterlogging and a foul smell. Farmer leader warned of a major agitation if the debris was not removed quickly. Khatauli-specific; the 2025 date is older than preferred, but the issue is local.

statement_hindi: सरकार का काम ठीक है, कुछ लोग इसकी तारीफ करते हैं
statement_english: Government work is good, some residents say, and they praise it
basis: Amar Ujala ground report: some people praised government work; one citizen called the BJP or BSP government's rule good.

statement_hindi: महिलाओं की सुरक्षा पहले से बेहतर हुई है, पर और सुधार होना चाहिए
statement_english: Women's safety is better than before, but it should improve further
basis: Amar Ujala ground report: resident Ishita said women's safety is better than before but can improve further.

statement_hindi: प्रशासन के सुरक्षा इंतज़ाम अच्छे हैं
statement_english: The administration's security arrangements are good
basis: Amar Ujala ground report: residents praised the administration's security arrangements (paraphrased in the report, not a direct quote).

statement_hindi: *युवाओं में पढ़ाई को लेकर उत्साह दिखता है
statement_english: *Young people are keen on education
basis: Inference: the Amar Ujala report records resident Faiz naming education as a key youth demand alongside ending unemployment. That is a demand, not evidence of improvement or enthusiasm, so this is a weak positive to verify in the field.

statement_hindi: *कुछ परिवारों को सरकारी योजनाओं का फायदा मिल रहा है
statement_english: *Some families are getting benefits from government schemes
basis: Inference only: no Meerapur-specific scheme or delivered benefit was found in any source checked in round 2. The Amar Ujala report's only related sourced point is the citizen praising the BJP or BSP government's rule. Replaces the round 1 item 'people speak openly about development', which was not a voter-appreciated benefit. Field check needed (ration, pension, housing or Ayushman coverage in Meerapur).

statement_hindi: मीरापुर में सड़कों पर गड्ढे हैं, मरम्मत होनी चाहिए
statement_english: Roads in Meerapur have potholes and need proper repair work
basis: Amar Ujala ground report (Meerapur series, 26 Aug 2026): Shreya Sharma wants better road quality and potholes fixed; farmers quoted in the report said road work should happen. The report labels these voices 'Morna area', but Morna is not in this AC's Wikipedia extent list, so the place name was dropped from the statement. The AC-level road complaint is what the source supports.

statement_hindi: गन्ने के दाम बढ़ने चाहिए, किसान की मेहनत का दाम मिले
statement_english: Sugarcane prices should go up, and farmers should get fair value for their hard work
basis: Amar Ujala ground report: farmers quoted in the report said sugarcane prices should rise. The report labels them 'Morna area', which is not confirmed as inside this AC, so this item is not counted as AC-specific. No Meerapur mill dues were found in round 2 searches.

statement_hindi: शिक्षा और इलाज मुफ्त होने चाहिए
statement_english: Education and healthcare should be free
basis: Amar Ujala ground report: resident Sanjeev Kumar (labelled 'Morna area' in the report, which is not confirmed as inside this AC) said education and medical care should be free.

statement_hindi: बेरोजगारी खत्म होनी चाहिए, युवाओं को काम चाहिए
statement_english: Unemployment must end; youth need jobs
basis: Amar Ujala ground report: Faiz said the youth's biggest demands are education and ending unemployment. Mohit Dubey also wanted the MLA to focus on development and jobs.

statement_hindi: मीरापुर में विकास की कमी दिखती है, बुनियादी सुविधाओं पर ध्यान चाहिए
statement_english: Development is lacking in Meerapur; basic facilities need attention
basis: Amar Ujala ground report: residents voiced concern about lack of development and basic facilities in Meerapur (paraphrased in the report, not village-specific). Meerapur is the town and Nagar Panchayat inside this AC per the Wikipedia extent list.

statement_hindi: नजीबाबाद में वंदे भारत रुकने लगी, अब सफर आसान है
statement_english: A Vande Bharat train now stops at Najibabad, making travel easier
basis: Dehradun-Lucknow Vande Bharat Express now halts at Najibabad (Najibabad Junction); it was flagged off by Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly Speaker Ritu Khanduri at the Najibabad Junction event. Article dated 10 Dec 2024.

statement_hindi: कोटद्वार रोड पर ईडब्ल्यूएस मकान और प्लॉट बनकर तैयार हो गए
statement_english: EWS houses and plots on Kotdwar Road in Najibabad have been completed
basis: UP RERA registry entry shown on an aggregator: 'Kotdwar Road Yojna No-01, Najibabad 3rd Phase', promoter U.P. Awas Evam Vikas Parishad, taluka Najibabad, 111 residential plots and 100 EWS houses, status 'Completed', completion date 31 Oct 2025. This is a registry record, not a news report. Allotment and handover to beneficiaries are not confirmed. Tehsil-level, AC membership not confirmed.

statement_hindi: बिजनौर की महिलाओं की हर्बल टी की विदेश से फ्रेंचाइज़ी मांग आई है
statement_english: Bijnor women's herbal tea has drawn franchise demand from abroad
basis: District-level, not this AC: the group is in Tanda Maidas Lakhi Wala village, Kotwali block of Bijnor. Started with a Rs 1 lakh loan under NRLM. The article says the US, England, Germany and France have sent franchise demand or are planned franchise targets; it does not confirm exports. Article dated 14 Jul 2026.

statement_hindi: * गरीबों के लिए राशन और उज्ज्वला गैस जैसी योजनाएं गांव तक पहुंची हैं
statement_english: * Free ration and Ujjwala gas schemes have reached villages
basis: Inference: statewide welfare schemes. No Najibabad or Bijnor report on delivery of these schemes in this AC was found in 2024-26 searches. Field check needed before use.

statement_hindi: * सरकारी अस्पताल में इलाज और दवा की सुविधा मिल रही है
statement_english: * Government hospital treatment and medicines are available to people
basis: Inference: no Najibabad hospital or health-facility report from 2024-26 was found; the hospital search returned only other cities. Unverified; field check needed.

statement_hindi: गुलदार ने जान ले ली, वन विभाग कुछ नहीं करता
statement_english: A leopard killed a woman, and the forest department is not acting
basis: Alopur village (the article says 'Jalalabad area', Bijnor district; its block and whether it falls in this AC are not confirmed): Babita Devi, 40, was taken by a leopard around 6 a.m. on 10 Sep 2026. Villagers refused to move the body until a case was registered against forest staff. BKU workers blocked the road at the Double Phatak flyover in Najibabad town (in this AC). The SDM, CO and deputy ranger came to the spot. One incident in the article; the 'repeated attacks' point is not verified from the page.

statement_hindi: बारिश हुई तो मोहल्ले की गलियां और घर पानी में डूब जाते हैं
statement_english: Heavy rain floods our lanes and homes
basis: Rain on Mon 4 Aug 2025 in Najibabad town: in Mohalla Mughlushah and Maqbara area, many access roads and houses had two to three feet of water; dozens of houses flooded in the Thatheron wali mosque area of Mughlushah; heavy waterlogging on Ajmal Khan Road; students had trouble reaching school. This is one event; no 2026 report found.

statement_hindi: वन विभाग फसल उजाड़ रहा है, किसानों का शोषण हो रहा है
statement_english: The forest department destroyed our crops and exploits farmers
basis: Fri 9 Jan 2026: Bharatiya Kisan Union (Tikait) farmers marched on foot from the Bijnor DFO office to the tehsil premises (headline names Najibabad). Farmers said the forest department destroyed their crops and that the department is exploiting farmers. District-level (Bijnor DFO), not AC-only.

statement_hindi: * गन्ने का पैसा सालों से अटका है, मिलें टालती रहती हैं
statement_english: * Sugarcane payments from the mills stay stuck for years and the mills keep delaying
basis: Inference: no Najibabad or Bijnor cane-dues report from 2024-26 was found. The sources are old or not specific: Gaon Connection, 13 Sep 2019, UP-wide (ISMA says UP mills owe farmers Rs 6,480 crore; the CM's 31 Aug payment promise was missed); The Quint, 27 Sep 2019, Bijnor farmers say about nine mills owe 'Rs 500 crore' 'since 2018' (farmers' claim, not verified); Amar Ujala, 30 Dec 2022, Bilai Chini Mill, Bijnor district (farmers met the District Cane Officer; mill promised Rs 1.7 crore a day; mill's tehsil not stated). Persistence to 2026 not confirmed.

statement_hindi: * नजीबाबाद के नाले गंदे रहते हैं, बारिश में पानी निकलता नहीं
statement_english: * Drains in Najibabad stay dirty and rainwater does not drain away
basis: Inference: no 2024-26 report on Najibabad drain condition was found. Based on the Aug 2025 Mughlushah waterlogging (negative 2) and the absence of any drain-cleaning report found. Field check needed. This is the one AC-town negative with no source.

statement_hindi: * जंगल के पास के खेतों में गन्ना बोया जाता है
statement_english: * Sugarcane is grown on farms near the forest edge
basis: Inference: the ICAR study of Najibabad forest division (Indian Journal of Animal Sciences) says sugarcane fields near the forest edge are raided by elephants more than rice, wheat or vegetables, so sugarcane is grown there. It does not say sugarcane is a main cash crop. District-level, not Nagina AC-specific.

statement_hindi: * सड़क जाम हो तो प्रशासन और पुलिस जल्दी मौके पर पहुँचते हैं
statement_english: * When a road is blocked, police and administration reach the spot quickly
basis: Inference: no Nagina AC source found. A 2018 Patrika report on a road blockade in Bijnor city shows officials came and cleared a jam, but Bijnor city is outside Nagina AC, so it is not cited. Needs a field check.

statement_hindi: * सरकारी राशन और योजनाएँ गाँव तक पहुँचती हैं
statement_english: * Government ration and schemes reach villages in the area
basis: Inference: no source found. Generic positive for a rural-town AC; needs a field check.

statement_hindi: * छोटी दुकानें और बाज़ार रोज़मर्रा का काम चलाए रखते हैं
statement_english: * Local shops and markets keep daily life going
basis: Inference: no source found. Included only as a generic positive for a town constituency; needs a field check.

statement_hindi: * पास की नहर और नदी से खेतों को पानी मिल जाता है
statement_english: * Fields get water from nearby canals and rivers
basis: Inference: no source found. Included as a generic positive for a Ganga-belt farming area; needs a field check.

statement_hindi: हाथी रास्ते तक आ जाते हैं, वन विभाग देर से आता है
statement_english: Wild elephants come up to village paths, and the forest team arrives late
basis: Rampur Chadha village (Mandawali area, Bhaguwala chowki), Bijnor district: on 1 May 2026 a woman was killed by a wild elephant on the path to fetch milk. Villagers said the forest team and chowki in-charge reached about two hours after they were informed, and demanded strong safety arrangements. District-level; Nagina AC membership of this village is not confirmed.

statement_hindi: बाढ़ का पानी घटा, पर गाँवों की सड़कें अब भी बंद हैं
statement_english: After flood water recedes, village roads are still closed
basis: Jaleelpur, Ganga khadar area, Bijnor district (Amar Ujala, 3 Aug 2026): after the water fell, bikes and cars still could not reach nine villages, tractor-trolleys were the only transport, and several connecting roads were damaged. District-level; Nagina AC membership of Jaleelpur is not confirmed.

statement_hindi: * बारिश में बिजली गुल, इन्वर्टर भी खत्म हो जाते हैं
statement_english: * Power goes off during rain, and inverters run out
basis: Inference: no Nagina AC source found. Power cuts after rain are reported for Bijnor city (Patrika, 4 Aug 2025), but Bijnor city is outside Nagina AC, so it is not cited. Needs a field check.

statement_hindi: जंगल के किनारे हाथी गन्ने के खेत उजाड़ जाते हैं
statement_english: Elephants raid sugarcane fields near the forest edge
