basis: Najibabad forest division study, Bijnor district (Indian Journal of Animal Sciences, Vol. 90 No. 8, 2020; online listing 2025-09-09): elephant is the most problematic crop raider, followed by nilgai; sugarcane fields closer to the forest edge are raided more by elephants than rice, wheat or vegetables. District-level academic study; villages not named.

statement_hindi: लकड़ी के कारीगरों को कच्चे माल, पैसे और बाज़ार की दिक्कत है
statement_english: Wood craft workers struggle with raw material, money and markets
basis: Bijnor district wood handicraft study (MBA thesis, Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture and Technology, hosted on Shodhganga; no date, data to 2023-24): abstract says raw material shortages, financial constraints and market barriers persist, though units grew from 510 (2009-10) to 1,050 (2023-24). District-level; the abstract does not name Nagina, so the Nagina link is not verified.

statement_hindi: कुछ मिलें समय पर गन्ने का पैसा दे रही हैं
statement_english: Some mills are paying cane money on time
basis: District Cane Officer P.N. Singh said nearly six mills in the district are ahead in making payments to farmers; four mills still owe over Rs 195 crore (district-level; none of the named mills is stated to be in AC 19).

statement_hindi: गन्ने का दाम बढ़ा है, और समय पर पैसा मिल रहा है
statement_english: Cane prices have gone up, and we are getting payment on time
basis: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, speaking in Bijnor, said farmers are receiving timely payments and sugarcane prices had been increased. This is a government claim, not voter testimony (district-level).

statement_hindi: बिजनौर और चांदपुर में 1,003 करोड़ से ज्यादा की 76 परियोजनाएं शुरू हुईं
statement_english: Over Rs 1,003 crore worth of 76 projects started in Bijnor and Chandpur
basis: CM inaugurated and laid foundation stones for 76 projects worth over Rs 1,003 crore in the Bijnor and Chandpur assembly constituencies (upcmnews, 18 July 2026). Barhapur is not named in the source (district-level).

statement_hindi: चीनी मिलों में 20 अक्टूबर के आसपास पेराई शुरू होने की उम्मीद है
statement_english: Sugar mill crushing is expected to start around 20 October, subject to weather
basis: Crushing 'likely to begin around October 20, subject to weather conditions' (western UP, district-level). Bijnor is named in the report's district list. This is an expectation, not a completed event.

statement_hindi: मंडावर नगर पंचायत में नई पेयजल योजना शुरू हो गई है
statement_english: A new drinking water scheme has started in Mandawar nagar panchayat
basis: CM inaugurated the Mandawar Nagar Panchayat reconstitution drinking water scheme under AMRUT 2.0 (upcmnews, 18 July 2026). Mandawar is not among the AC 19 units named on Wikipedia, so this is district-level, not AC 19.

statement_hindi: बारिश में अफजलगढ़ बिजलीघर टपकता है, बिजली घंटों गुल रहती है
statement_english: Rain leaks into the Afzalgarh power station control room, and power is cut for hours
basis: Afzalgarh power station control-room roof leaks in rain and water halts supply. On 12 July 2026 supply was cut from about midnight to 4 pm, with only 1-2 hours of power in that period (AC-specific: Afzalgarh is in AC 19 per Wikipedia).

statement_hindi: बिलाई मिल पर किसानों का 41 करोड़ से ज्यादा गन्ना बकाया है
statement_english: Cane farmers are still owed over Rs 41 crore by Bilai sugar mill
basis: Bilai Sugar Mill owes farmers Rs 41.98 crore, per District Sugarcane Officer Brajesh Kumar Patel; farmer organisations protested and demanded immediate payment. The mill's town is not stated (district-level, Bijnor).

statement_hindi: अफजलगढ़ सीएचसी में पानी भरा, मरीजों को दवा नहीं मिली
statement_english: Water flooded Afzalgarh CHC, and patients could not get medicines
basis: Afzalgarh CHC flooded 2-3 feet deep after rain; medicine store and records damaged. A patient said patients could not get medicines because of the water (Amar Ujala, Afzalgarh dateline, 7 Sept 2026). AC-specific.

statement_hindi: अफजलगढ़ में अमला पुल की सड़क धंसी, 25 गांवों का रास्ता कटा
statement_english: In Afzalgarh, the Amla bridge road sank, cutting off 25 villages
basis: Soil under the approach road of the old Amla river bridge in Afzalgarh slid; all vehicles were halted; 25+ villages and several Kadrabad-area colonies were cut off. No repair timeline given (Amar Ujala, 29 May 2026). No later update found. AC-specific.

statement_hindi: इस बरसात में चौथी बार सड़कों पर बाढ़ का पानी लौटा
statement_english: Floodwater came back onto the roads for the fourth time this monsoon
basis: Water flowing again on the state highway (Bahsuma-Thakurdwara) and flood-affected area roads; the report says it is the fourth time this monsoon. Datelined Jaleelpur; Jaleelpur's AC is not confirmed as AC 19 (district-level).

statement_hindi: हमारे विधायक और चेयरमैन ने अब तक बहुत अच्छा काम किया है
statement_english: The local MLA and chairman have done very good work so far
basis: Voter Shahreen (शहरीन) said the local MLA and chairman have done very good work so far (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). Single-voice praise of leaders, not a named project.

statement_hindi: यहां काफी काम हुआ है, कुछ हद तक चीजें बदली हैं
statement_english: A lot of work has been done here, and some changes are visible
basis: Voter Rachit Kumar said a lot of work has been done; voter Preet Kumar Chauhan said things have changed to some extent, though expectations were not fully met (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026).

statement_hindi: हमारे कॉलेज का स्पोर्ट्स बहुत अच्छा है
statement_english: The college's sports facilities are very good
basis: Voter Matiha Zaidi said the sports facilities of her college are very good (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). She also praised her teachers; that part is not quoted here.

statement_hindi: उत्तर प्रदेश की सरकार से कोई परेशानी नहीं
statement_english: There is no trouble with the state government
basis: Dr. N.P. Singh said there is no trouble with the Uttar Pradesh government (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). Single-voice view, not a survey, and not a delivered benefit.

statement_hindi: धामपुर में सखी सेंटर का स्टाफ तैनात है, पर अभी खुला नहीं
statement_english: Staff are appointed for the Sakhi centre in Dhampur, but it is not open yet
basis: Amar Ujala video report (25 Mar 2026): Sakhi One Stop Centre unit-2 at the 100-bed hospital campus on Nagina Road, Dhampur; five women appointed through outsourcing; centre not yet inaugurated, launch expected from April. Weakest positive: a sourced staffing step, not an open service, and no later report confirms it opened.

statement_hindi: काफी काम हुआ, पर यहां पानी की समस्या आज भी बनी हुई है
statement_english: There is still a water problem here despite the work done
basis: Voter Rachit Kumar said there is a water problem even though a lot of work has been done (Dhampur town reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). Dhampur Municipal Board also approved a Rs 1 crore drinking water pipeline as a planned item, not a completed one (Amar Ujala, 7 Jan 2026).

statement_hindi: चीनी मिल समय पर भुगतान नहीं करेगी तो हम उसे गन्ना नहीं देंगे
statement_english: If a sugar mill does not pay on time, we will not give it our cane
basis: District-level, not Dhampur-specific: Amar Ujala (Bijnor, 4 Oct 2026) reports BKU (Arajneeti)'s 'no payment, no cane' campaign against the Bilai sugar mill in Bijnor district, and a demand that its cane area be allotted to mills that pay on time. The dues amount is not stated in that article. Bilai is not among the areas listed for Dhampur AC on Wikipedia.

statement_hindi: बरसात में सड़कों पर पानी भर जाता है, आवागमन में दिक्कत होती है
statement_english: Roads get waterlogged in the monsoon and transport gets disrupted
basis: Voter Rachit Kumar said roads were waterlogged in this and the previous monsoon, causing transport trouble (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026).

statement_hindi: जल निगम का काम जर्जर है, किसी गांव में टंकी पूरी नहीं हुई
statement_english: The Jal Nigam work here is dilapidated, and no village water tank has been completed
basis: Voter Chaudhary Kaviraj said a structure dug by Jal Nigam is lying dilapidated and that no water tank has been completed in any village so far (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). The article's wording is about a dug structure/drain linked to the tank; the tank itself is not described in detail.

statement_english: There is a shortage of fertiliser and farmers are struggling
basis: Farmer Mahendra Pal Singh raised a shortage of fertiliser (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). Single-voice view, no place named, so not AC-specific.
